content_of_post_to_answer: What makes certain characters or plots stick with us and become part of who we are?
answer: Characters and plots stay with us when they stop feeling like stories and start acting as mirrors. We rarely remember every detail; we remember the moments that gave language to something we had felt but couldn't explain. I've written more about this kind of connection on my profile if you want to explore the pattern further. The most lasting fiction does not tell us who to become—it reveals parts of ourselves we were already carrying.
